# PDF to EPUB Converter

Free web app: https://w1neskin.github.io/pdf-epub-converter/

## What it is
An online tool that converts a PDF file into an EPUB book. Users sign in, upload a PDF, wait for conversion, then download the EPUB or read it in the browser.

## Facts
- Price: free. A free account is required.
- Limits: 50MB file size, 100 pages.
- Output: EPUB with extracted text and images.
- Library: signed-in users can store and reopen converted books.
- Not a local business. No street address. Use it from any country in a browser.

## How to use
1. Open the site and create an account.
2. Upload a PDF.
3. Download the EPUB or read it on the site.
